purpose: Keep candidate JavaScript out of the trusted node:test process while observing package-root HTML behavior through a bounded JSON projection.

operations.inspect: Return package metadata and runtime export kinds without exposing implementation bytes.
operations.constants: Return the public namespace constants, selected error-code values, default-adapter method names, and compatibility export kinds.
operations.parse: Parse one bounded HTML document and return a cycle-free projection, canonical serialization, and ordered parse errors.
operations.fragment: Parse one bounded fragment with an optional HTML or SVG context and return a cycle-free projection plus serialization.
operations.outer: Parse a fragment and serialize one selected child with serializeOuter.
